summary: A Yes vote continues the City of Santa Ana's existing 1.5% transactions and use (sales) tax at its current rate to fund general city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote makes the sales tax permanent instead of allowing its scheduled sunsets.
tax.quote: seeks to make permanent a sales tax that was initially pitched to voters as temporary.

tax.text: A No vote leaves the existing sales tax reductions and termination schedule in place.
